name: Via Blank
description: Import an SRM-20 via blank into the open board.
description_full: Drops the plated hole pattern and F.Cu ground plane of a fab-made via blank into the board you already have, clipped to its outline and locked so automatic placement will not move it. The blank is a two-layer board with solid copper on both faces tied together by plated 1.0 mm holes: F.Cu is a ground plane you only relieve, B.Cu is the layer the mill isolates into traces, and ground stops needing hand-soldered wire vias.
